text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан continues to run with
everything she's
got, but she realizes
that she is physically
reaching her peak
as an athlete.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Still, despite the pain that comes with it,
all she
can do to satisfy herself is
continue running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган recognizes Narita
Brian's true
intentions behind her
racing...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She vows that, just as Нарита Брайан once
excited
her, she will excite Нарита Брайан
with her own
running abilities.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
